title: Virgil van Dijk defends Liverpool players’ time off before Manchester United defeat
content:
Captain Virgil van Dijk has defended the amount of time off given to the Liverpool squad by head coach Arne Slot.

A lot of the players went on city breaks in Europe at the start of last week before returning to Merseyside ahead of Sunday’s 3-2 defeat to Manchester United.

The manner of the setback at Old Trafford, with Slot’s side 2-0 down inside 14 minutes, raised questions about their preparations, but Van Dijk rejected the idea that a lack of time spent on the training ground contributed to their struggles.

“A few days off? You mean one day off,” Van Dijk said. “I’m not sure it’s a holiday. It’s a city trip. They decide what they want to do with their families. We are not kids. Everyone is an adult.

“Yesterday (Saturday) we were in a hotel. Today we played. So two days away with the family again. It’s not that we have a holiday whatsoever.

“I wish we had a couple more days off at times because I think it works both ways. You see Pep Guardiola giving (Manchester) City three days off the last weeks in a row and they are doing pretty well. It is about finding the right balance.

“I can understand if people think we are not training and, when results are not there, that it could be a reason for why we are not getting results.”

Sunday was Liverpool’s 18th defeat of a miserable season and they need four points from their remaining three games to guarantee themselves Champions League qualification for next season.

“I’m not here to make excuses,” Van Dijk told reporters post-match at Old Trafford.

“It’s been an unacceptable season. It’s not Liverpool. We have to make sure that we are in the Champions League because of the impact of it for the financial side for the club. But also because we want to be playing in it against the best teams in Europe.

“There is a lot of work to be done behind the scenes (this summer). I want this to be solved. I want us to be successful. Consistency is the most difficult thing in any job you do. This season cannot be repeated.”
